messages:
Alice: quick thought 11 should we surface a per-request unit-econ row in the cost dash? folks keep asking for real marginal cost (tokens billed minus cache) :thinking_face:
Ben: yes please. commercial teams want 'cache actually saved' numbers when negotiating pricing.
Carla: big hairy bit is attribution when we have prefix cache + kv-cache + cross-route reuse.
Dave: also streaming/tool-call flow weirdness - tokens can be emitted after initial response. do we tie them back to the root request?
Emma: my draft: emit a compact telemetry event per request (no prompt text) with numeric fields only. minimal shape below:

```json
{
  "req_id": "uuid",
  "tenant_id": "tid",
  "route": "/v1/chat/summarize",
  "model_variant": "llama2-q4_1",
  "tokens_total": 120,
  "tokens_billed": 85,
  "tokens_from_cache": 35,
  "kv_cache_hit_tokens": 12,
  "prefix_cache_hit_tokens": 23,
  "model_level_rate": 0.00012,
  "model_latency_ms": 230,
  "fallback_reason": null,
  "is_streaming": true
}
```

Emma: UI can compute raw_cost = tokens_billed * model_level_rate, cache_credit = tokens_from_cache * model_level_rate, amortized_cost = raw_cost - cache_credit.
Ben: smart. how do we avoid a telemetry deluge? we can't ship full events for 100% QPS.
Carla: keep shape tiny as above. sample 1% full events that include an anonymized prompt fingerprint for quality/debug. others emit only numeric counters (same fields but as aggregated counters).
Alice: add a flag for "is_canary" so we can slice per-rollout unit economics. helpful for A/B/gradual rollouts.
Dave: streaming attribution: prefer to attach tokens to parent req_id unless a new tool invocation creates a separate logical request (then set parent_tool_call_id).
Carla: cross-route cache fills: for billing transparency, attribute the saving to the consumer (the request that used the cached tokens). separately emit "cache_populate" events so we can show which route created the item. UI offers two modes: consumption and populator.
Ben: cool UX: per-route timeline sparkline showing fills/hits with hover metadata listing the populator route and timestamps.
Emma: retention proposal: keep full per-request econ events at full fidelity for 90 days, then roll-up monthly aggregates to reduce storage.
infra-bot: FYI deploy scheduled: telemetry-producer v2 -> edge next Tue, sampling config lives at /configs/telemetry/sampling.yml :rocket:
Ben: another ask: let product simulate "what-if" model swaps in the dashboard (e.g., swap llama2-q8 -> q4_1 quantized). show delta using median tokens * rate diff + CI from token distribution.
Emma: we can derive that from p50/p95 token histograms and per-model rate. include model_level_rate in events so UI doesn't need synchronous catalog joins.
Carla: legal/privacy: no prompt text. only store hashed/salted prompt fingerprints for debug, and only on opt-in for evals.
Alice: implementation CRs:
- Emma: open telemetry schema PR (small, PII-free)
- Carla: author sampling + retention doc + legal note
- Dave: implement streaming/tool-call linking in runtime
- Ben: prototype dashboard toggle: 'consumption' vs 'populator' view + model-swap sim

Ben: one more: add boolean "cache_credit_claimed" to event so downstream billing can optionally reconcile credits. but keep dashboard and billing decoupled until legal ok.
Carla: agreed, billing is a second-phase project. must get finance & legal sign-off before auto credits.
Alice: neat. drop PR links + mockups in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
